evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a known production failure as something to reproduce carries low-arousal, mildly negative valence — a weary recognition of a recurring defect rather than alarm or urgency.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.
